claim: Hooks never fail the developer's session: every hook exits 0 on any error; the Gate is the only deliberate non-zero exit (2), used once per turn.
The Gate holds a code-editing turn at most once: when stop_hook_active is set the turn is let through, and documentation-only edits are never held.
A small change (under small_change_chars characters in at most small_change_files files) is not asked for tests or for recording learnings; only citations and open flares apply.
Retrieval and the session-start orientation return only active facts; stale-candidate and contradicted facts are never handed to an agent unless explicitly requested.

A fact becomes a stale candidate when an identifier it names no longer appears in its evidence files nor anywhere in the repository; evidence-based doubts are lifted automatically when the evidence returns.
A cited evidence file counts as existing if it exists in this checkout or is tracked in any git worktree of the repository.
Before the agent edits a file, a PreToolUse hook returns additionalContext with the open flares and active facts attached to that file, shown once per file per session.
In model mode hooks do not extract facts; they register transcript byte ranges, and the dream lets the model read those ranges in chunks, validating cited files and dropping made-up paths.
New or changed Claude Code auto-memory notes for the repository are offered to the ledger as candidates, except notes of type user, and unchanged notes are not offered twice.

Every captured turn produces a journal record with the ask, the files edited, the commit messages parsed from git commands, whether tests ran, and the branch; dreams write them to one markdown file per day.
A commit message that names an open flare's id marks the flare fixed at the next dream, with the commit message as the note.
An open flare whose anchor files no longer exist is set to needs_human by the dream, and the console lists flares open for 14 days or more as decisions with still-valid, won't-fix and gone actions.

The final assistant message of an editing turn is stored as the branch's handoff unless an explicit handoff newer than six hours exists; the latest handoff for the current branch is shown at session start when younger than 14 days.

Dreams read new commits from all branches since the last pass, skip bots and cosmos's own ledger commits, write one journal line per commit, and offer commit bodies of 60+ characters to the model as candidates.
When the GitHub CLI is logged in, review comments on the repository's pull requests since the last pass are offered as candidates, skipping bots, short remarks and praise.
.cosmos is a git worktree of a branch named cosmos, ignored by the repository's other branches; dreams commit and push it in the background, and conflicts fall back to a merge that keeps local files.
The hook command attaches the cosmos branch as a worktree on a fresh clone when origin/cosmos exists, and falls back to the main worktree's .cosmos from any git worktree.

The watcher tails every Claude, Codex and Gemini session file for the repository including all worktrees and subagents, captures new turns like a hook would, keeps a live picture, and exits after two idle hours; session starts restart it.
A dream starts by itself, detached from the hook, when at least 25 observations wait, or hourly while session ranges wait, or six hours after the last dream; a lock prevents concurrent dreams.
Observations the model drops as noise are marked as processed so they never resurface as raw facts in a later dream.
Each dream records recall@5 over the ledger: for facts with evidence the query is the evidence file, and for facts with a model-written question the query is that question.
Facts handed to an agent are one line each, cut at a word boundary near 140 characters, with the fact id, so the full note can be requested; each injection is logged with its estimated token count.

cosmos_remember accepts fact, note, content, rule or memory as the text field, and cosmos_flare accepts text, summary or finding as the title; when the field is missing the reply names the field and shows an example.
cosmos_remember kind=rule records an explicit human rule at importance 0.95; the default kind records an agent fact with source agent and lower importance.
A file under any git worktree of the repository is recorded repo-relative; only files outside every worktree are recorded as sibling-repository paths.
Text is passed through secret redaction before it is stored, and an observed fact that needed redaction is discarded rather than kept.
Lanes assigned by the model take precedence; path-based inference fills in only facts without a lane, and sibling-repository and external paths are ignored for lane inference.
The Atlas fingerprints the source files it read and reports drift when any of them changed or went missing since generation.
At session start the Charter summary is injected before facts, and explicit rules (source explicit) rank ahead of inferred facts in the orientation set.
cosmos doctor reports paths named in the Charter that do not exist in any worktree, ignoring placeholders such as path/to/file.py:123.
